annotations.coverageReview: Fresh six-view survey, native front/side frames and original/expanded overlays inspected. Ancient Crane has one head. Upper gray crown/face, central bill, lower bill tip and white side cheek/jaw cover the visible head. Sparse battle geometry required reviewed radii .12–.14; minimum patch 26 vertices. Crest, neck, wings, feet and all animation/technique coverage remain pending. Revised side cheek pick [148,150] with .12 radius independently inspected after the prior expanded sample reached the flexible curved neck. Final yellow patch stays on white cheek, minimum battle patch 23 vertices; source and battle 468-blend checks pass. No face repair is authorized from the superseded neck-contaminated sample.
